title: Terms beside the audit
direction: A×C · Round 8 · /the-lab · split close (SC), on paper
summary: The kit's split close on the page's one paper moment: early access set out as a terms sheet you could hold (Asks · Returns · Your data, with what stays yours and what the Lab keeps side by side) ending on a quiet application link, beside the audit as the page's one red door.
story: Routes interest correctly, which is the page's job. A reader who wants a hand in the instruments gets the honest terms and a quiet way to apply (round 7, C5); a reader who wants the service is told plainly that it comes first and starts with the audit, and what the audit returns for this subject. The onward link sends both to where the instruments will be used.
copy: [K, lightly edited] Asks: A sales-carried B2B motion with live pipeline to instrument · Read access to the signals we measure — anonymised, exportable, yours · One named operator in a working session, twice a month · [R] Tolerance for rough edges while it’s being built
[R, edited — founder flag D11] Returns: A first look at each instrument · A hand in what ships · A direct line into the build (the story map's “to the people building it” implied a team)
[R Privacy L·07] Your data: Stays yours — The system, the assets, your data, your documents · The Lab keeps — Anonymised, aggregated patterns, as your engagement agreement spells out
[K, round-7 C5] Quiet .ac-link “Apply for early access” → /contact?topic=lab&ref=Early%20Access%20Protocol
[R] (FC) Note “Audit and install clients are offered places first. If the fit isn’t there yet, we say so.”
[N] Door line (h3) “The service comes first, and it starts with the audit.”

[N] (FC §7 Q3 for “intelligence gap report”) Door sub “Ten working days, read-only access, and a written readout you keep. Its intelligence gap report names what your system can’t see yet.” (ten days, read-only and the kept readout are confirmed D8 facts)
[K] Red “Request a System Audit” → /audit · quiet “Talk to the team” → /contact
[N] Onward “Where these instruments are used” → GTM Intelligence
